simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to מָלַל (H4448) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.

simple.summary: מָלַל (mâlal) means to speak (mostly poetical) or say First listed occurrence: Gen 21 7.

definitions.full: H4448. malal I. [ מָלַל ] verb Pi`el speak, utter, say (Late Hebrew Pi`el id. ; Aramaic (and many derivatives ), מַלֵּל ; perhaps compare Arabic IV. dictate (a letter, etc.), () IV id. Nö ZMG xi. 1886, 725 ); — Pi`el Perfect מִלֵּל Gen 21:7 ; compare 1singular מַלּוֺתִי (Ew §274 b. N ) as proper name below; מִלֵּ֑לוּ Job 33:3 ; Imperfect יְמַלֵּל Psa 106:2 ; תְּמַלֶּלֿ Job 8:2 ; — say, followed by direct quotation + לְ of indirect object Gen 21:7 ; utter, object דַּ֫עַת Job 33:3 ; compare 8:2 ; object י ׳גְּבוּרוֺת Psa 106:2 . II. [ מָלַל ] verb rub, scrape (Late Hebrew id., rub ears of wheat, scrape ); — only Qal Participle מוֺלֵל in בְּאֶצְבְּעֹתָיו מֹרֶה בְּרַגְלָ֑ו֯ מוֺלֵל בְּעֵינָו֯ קֹרֵץ Prov 6:13 he that winketh with his eyes, that scrapeth with his feet (making signs), etc., so De Now Str < Ew Wild from I. מלל that speaketh with his feet .
